formulas.aggregation: One out-of-fold prediction per original transition; pool observed rows, not unweighted fold metrics; two training seeds repeat these same baseline predictions, not new cases.
formulas.brier: mean((p-y)^2) on observed heldout targets only
formulas.grouping: Hold all exact keys-length/fault family rows together across destination/schema/replicate; nine families.
formulas.laplace_exact_feature_table: (matching entry-feature training positive count + 1) / (matching entry-feature observed count + 2); fallback constant only if pattern absent
formulas.log_loss: mean(-y*ln(p)-(1-y)*ln(1-p)) on observed heldout targets only
formulas.mask: Only original subsequent actor-readback boolean labels in the other families enter training counts; None is never coerced to false.

limits.important_denominator_distinction: The table accuracy40%=32/80 observed old-TRAIN completion forecasts; it is not the fixed-workflow operational completion80%=512/640 confirmation executions. No conversion or efficacy comparison is valid between them.

single_full_model_empirical_bounds.reason: Two ambiguous entry vectors have equal true/false counts; the matched=0.5 vector has32 true outcomes. These are descriptive corpus constraints, not measured model gains.
single_full_model_empirical_bounds.scope: On all80 observed original TRAIN rows, one deterministic predictor using only the exact three entry-feature vectors. These bounds do not constrain differing fold-specific models.
